issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' — code style rule 5 explicitly forbids this pattern. The comment '# CI fills this' indicates the url attribute is an unfilled template placeholder left for CI to populate, which the rule states indicates the recipe is incomplete.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set url to the recipe repository URL (e.g., the cnb.cool recipe hosting URL) or remove the url attribute entirely and delete the '# CI fills this' comment.

issues.description: build_system: custom is not among the listed valid values (cmake | autotools | makefile | meson) defined in code style rule 14. While JNA genuinely uses a custom build approach (direct compiler invocation via self.run), the value is outside the documented schema.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either add 'custom' to the valid build_system values in the code style rules documentation, or add a note explaining why 'custom' is used for this package. No code change strictly needed if the CI tooling accepts 'custom'.

issues.description: patches_applied section lists 5 header files (jni.h, jni_md.h, com_sun_jna_*.h) as 'patches_applied', but conandata.yml has patches: {} (empty) and no .patch files exist in the patches/ directory. The header files are bundled source headers exported via exports_sources = 'patches/*.h', not applied via the Conan patch mechanism. Additionally, line 18 describes jni_md.h as 'Platform-specific JNI header (Linux/aarch64)' which should reference HarmonyOS/OHOS instead of Linux since this is a HarmonyOS adaptation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Rename patches_applied to bundled_headers or add a clarifying note that these are bundled source headers, not applied patches. Update the jni_md.h description from 'Linux/aarch64' to 'OHOS/aarch64' or 'HarmonyOS/aarch64'.

issues.description: R40 deep adaptation check: JNA's native component (libjnidispatch.so) deals with dlopen/dlsym and FFI callbacks, which falls under the '系统底层' (system-level) category including 'dl' (dynamic linking). The test_package verifies JNI symbol exports via dlsym (10 symbols checked), which is more than a trivial version() call, but it does not test actual FFI callback functionality or JNI method invocation. Per R40, this library should be marked as 'needs manual confirmation of adaptation completeness'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding a test that invokes a simple JNI function (e.g., Java_com_sun_jna_Native_initIDs) to verify the library works beyond symbol presence. Note: full FFI/JNI testing requires a JVM runtime which may not be available in Conan CI, so the current dlsym smoke test may be the practical maximum. Mark in PR review that manual verification of FFI callbacks on HarmonyOS is recommended.

issues.description: The 'shared' option is declared (options = {'shared': [True, False]}, default_options = {'shared': True}) but is never checked in the build() method. The build unconditionally uses '-shared' flag for all compilation/link commands (lines 103, 113, 118) regardless of the option value. Setting shared=False would still produce shared libraries.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either remove the 'shared' option entirely (recommended, since JNA native library must be shared for JNI System.load() to work — static linking is not meaningful for this use case), or implement conditional build logic that respects the option.
